rationale: Polish abbey attack by Ukrainian national continues as major diplomatic damage to Ukraine's image in key ally Poland; drone strikes on Russia represent new offensive action but no qualitative shift in war dynamics.

top_events.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
